darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Return status
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: ADDED 2026-09-01 (DAR-BE-026), replacing the withdrawn returnWorkflowStatus pill — see the retirement entry in SourceSystemConnectorFieldWriteSupport.RETIRED_FIELDS. This is the endpoint's ONLY return-status field. Holds Shopify's own Order.returnStatus, an OrderReturnStatus: IN_PROGRESS, INSPECTION_COMPLETE, NO_RETURN, RETURN_FAILED, RETURN_REQUESTED, RETURNED. Those are the values to type, and they are the ones Shopify itself shows: the admin renders IN_PROGRESS as 'Return in progress' and the order search spells it return_status:in_progress. The withdrawn field held a per-return ReturnStatus instead, whose in-progress value is spelled OPEN — a word on no surface an operator could see — so excluding IN_PROGRESS matched nothing and reported a zero count, which reads exactly like an undeployed feature. Present on EVERY row, refund and return alike, because it describes the whole ORDER: excluding IN_PROGRESS therefore drops an in-progress order's refund rows as well as its return, which is deliberate — the per-return field it replaced could never reach a refund row at all. Key always present, null when Shopify reports nothing, so a consumer can tell 'extract predates the field' from 'Shopify said nothing'. Exclude IN_PROGRESS to drop orders whose return has not finished yet.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: PREFERRED join key. The Shopify return reference: the SHOPIFY_RTN_ID identification where present, else SHOPIFY_RETURN_ID — the same pick REST makes. darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Refund or return ID
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RENAMED 2026-08-18 (was '$.records[*].eventId', labelled 'Event ID' then 'Refund or Return ID'): 'event' is this extractor's internal abstraction, not a Shopify term, and it surfaced verbatim on the rules board, the run summary and the diff columns. bareId-normalized identity — a REFUND id when refundOrReturnType is REFUND, a RETURN id when it is RETURN. Matches OMS externalId whichever kind it is: the single join key for returns reconciliation, with no precedence rule needed on either side.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Type
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RENAMED 2026-08-18 (was '$.records[*].eventType'). REFUND or RETURN — identifies which kind of id refundOrReturnId carries on this row. Not a join key; useful for filtering or as a comparison field.

darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.label: Created
darpan.reconciliation.SourceSystemConnec.description: RELABELLED (was 'Order created', then 'Event created'): the individual refund's or return's own creation date — a refund row carries the refund's createdAt, a return row carries the return's — never the order's creation date. Windowing filters on this field, not on any order-level date.
